name: smwgraphics-airship-doomship
title: Airship/Doomship
description:
A custom Airship/Doomship tileset I made.

Includes:

- 2 different Palettes (Standard Airships, and one similar to the redish ones in SMB3.) in both .pal and .palmask formats.
- 2 different levels (One for outside, if you use the default Sky BG, and one for the interior.)
- 4 ExGFX Files (Specified below)
- 2 Map16 Pages (One for the FG, one for BG.)

The Flames act like 25 and should be used with a hurt block that acts as 25, though you can make them act like 12F if you want.


See the Readme for other notes.
